description: Does Database.Close at depth one resolve the open level, and what does a recordset still held on that Database do afterwards? Workspaces(0).BeginTrans; change a; open dynaset rs on T and MoveFirst; Database.Close; DBEngine.Errors; read the row of rs, rs.MoveNext, DBEngine.Errors; Workspace.Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; release rs; read T through a fresh Workspace.
